application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

chemistry.note: Neither the release nor its paper or record states the cell chemistry.

units_released.note: Rule: the same vehicle as tumftm ID1, already counted there: its extra signals belong to that unit. Released unit identifiers require package-specific inspection.

cells_liion.source: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.etran.2022.100167 (paper/Wassiliadis_2022_eTransportation.pdf): nine modules (p. 9), each 12s2p with cells "joined in parallel pairs" (p. 4), 216 cells in the battery system (p. 5); 108s2p
cells_liion.note: The release's 108 cell-voltage channels are the 108 series pairs. The vehicle is tumftm's ID1, whose 216 cells tumftm already counts, so totals subtract them once (overlap_cells_liion).

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.source: cell_voltage_1 to cell_voltage_108 in the drives, through fielddata.loaders.tum_id3_2022 (tumftm ID1, whose release has no cell channels)

energy_mwh.note: The vehicle is tumftm ID1, counted once there. 58.8 kWh computed from the data (ratio 1.01 to the stated 58 kWh net) is a cross-check, not added (reports/checks/v12/tum_id3_2022_energy.csv).

span_unit_years.note: Same vehicle as tumftm ID1 (scripts/checks/tum_id3_vs_tumftm.py), counted once: no time falls outside ID1's span (2021-02-11 to 2021-12-08 lies inside 2021-02-01 to 2023-06-13).

obs_hours.note: Calendar spans are measurable, so observation-hours are not used.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://doi.org/10.14459/2022mp1656313; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention

overlap_cells_liion.source: tumftm counts 7 vehicles x 216 cells, ID1 among them (https://doi.org/10.1016/j.etran.2025.100518, p. 3)
overlap_cells_liion.note: Dedup rule (fielddata/counting.py): ID1's cells count once, under tumftm.

units_gross.note: Gross: its one vehicle, tumftm's ID1. Not used in totals.
